title: krn task value flags must accept values starting with --
body: krn task close --note (and other value flags) rejects a value that begins with '--': 'krn task close t-t34x7a8 --as done --note "--collect (#326) ..."' exited 64 with 'missing value for --note' on 2026-11-07. Acceptance: a value flag consumes the next argument unchanged even when it begins with '--', with a CLI test for --note "--x".
